disclaimer: Research artifact. Not clinically validated, not a medical device, not for patient care. The ECG and clinical outputs come from independently trained models on different patient populations and are not a combined risk score.
patient_linkage: not asserted: the ECG and clinical outputs below are independent and must not be combined

ecg.task: Beat-level arrhythmia class (AAMI N/S/V/F/Q) for each heartbeat, from a single-lead ECG at 360 Hz.

model.trained_on: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, DS1 records (de Chazal 2004 split)

ecg.score_semantics: Uncalibrated. Phase 1f measured mean predicted P(S) at 3.2x and P(F) at 14.5x the true class rates. Treat the scores as a ranking of beats, not as probabilities, until Phase 1f Stage B fits a correction.

clinical.training_data: MIMIC-III Clinical Database Demo v1.4: 100 patients, all of whom had died by the time PhysioNet selected them. Verifies the pipeline; cannot estimate clinical performance.
clinical.banner: PIPELINE VERIFICATION ONLY - NOT CLINICAL PERFORMANCE. These numbers come from the MIMIC-III Demo (100 patients, all of whom had died by the time PhysioNet selected them). The test split has a handful of patients; the confidence intervals show how little the point estimates mean. Do not quote them as model performance.

fusion.reason: No fusion model trained on genuinely paired ECG + clinical data exists. MIT-BIH and MIMIC-III contain different patients, so they cannot be paired; a paired source (MIMIC-III Waveform Matched Subset + credentialed MIMIC-III) is not available on this machine.
